tools.name: vision_helper_analyze_image
tools.description:
Analyze one or more images using a vision-capable model from OpenRouter, returning the model's analysis as text. Use this whenever you need to know what is in an image but you cannot see images yourself.

Default mode is **detailed analysis**: use it for thorough understanding — transcribe all readable text, describe objects/people/colors/layout, reason about ambiguous or complex content, or compare several images (pass an array, up to 5). It requests high reasoning effort and a higher token budget, and uses a high-quality model by default ('qwen/qwen3.8-max').

Pass **quick: true** for a fast, cheap analysis of a single image — a yes/no, a short caption, or an object/color check. Quick mode uses the quick model ('meta/muse-glimmer-30b'), caps output at 1024 tokens, and forces minimal reasoning.

Accepts an http(s) URL, local file path, file:// URI, data: URI, or raw base64. Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF are accepted (per OpenRouter); remote URLs are validated against private/internal hosts before fetching. Relative file paths resolve against the server's working directory — prefer absolute paths or URLs. If the model's provider is busy or fails transiently (429/5xx/timeout/network), the request is retried, then falls back to the fallback model ('google/gemini-3.7-flash') automatically (detailed mode).

The response is prefixed with the model and image sources used; long analyses are truncated at 25000 characters. Errors carry actionable guidance (missing key, invalid model, oversized image, unsupported format).

anyOf.description: A single image. Accepted forms: an http(s) URL, a local file path, a file:// URI, a data: URI (data:image/png;base64,...), or a raw base64 string.
Multiple images (up to 5) analyzed together, e.g. to compare screenshots.

image.description: Image to analyze: a URL, local file path, data URI, raw base64, or an array of these.

prompt.description: Optional instruction for the vision model describing what to look for. Example: 'Transcribe all text in this screenshot'. When omitted, a general detailed description is used.

model.description: OpenRouter model ID to use for vision analysis, e.g. 'qwen/qwen3.8-max'. Defaults to the OPENROUTER_MODEL environment variable, then to a built-in default. Use vision_helper_list_models to discover current vision-capable models.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for the vision model's answer.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-2). Lower is more deterministic.

quick.description: Set true for a fast, cheap analysis of a single image: uses the quick model (OPENROUTER_QUICK_MODEL), caps output at 1024 tokens, and forces minimal reasoning. Good for a quick yes/no, a short caption, or an object/color check.

tools.name: vision_helper_list_models
tools.description:
List vision-capable models currently available on OpenRouter, so you (or the user) can pick which model to use for image analysis.

Models are filtered to those that accept image input. Use the 'search' argument to narrow by provider or family (e.g. 'gemini', 'claude', 'qwen', 'gpt'), and limit/offset for pagination. Returns a compact list of model IDs with provider, context length, and input price.

Examples:
  - "Which vision models can I use?" -> no arguments
  - "Find a fast cheap vision model" -> search="flash"
  - "What vision models does Google offer?" -> search="google/gemini"

search.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on model ID or name, e.g. 'gemini', 'qwen', 'gpt'.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return.

offset.description: Number of models to skip, for pagination.

tools.name: vision_helper_check_config
tools.description:
Diagnose why vision analysis may be failing. Reports whether an OpenRouter API key is configured, where it was loaded from (MCP client environment, Windows user environment variables, or Windows system environment variables), which model would be used by default, and the configured size/time limits.

The key is only shown masked (e.g. sk-or-v1-…a0) — never in full.

Args:
  - (none)

Returns:
  A short markdown report with:
  - API key: present or missing, plus the source it was resolved from.
  - Default model: from OPENROUTER_MODEL, or the built-in default ('qwen/qwen3.8-max').
  - Quick model: from OPENROUTER_QUICK_MODEL, or the built-in default ('meta/muse-glimmer-30b').
  - Fallback model: tried automatically if the default model's provider is busy ('google/gemini-3.7-flash').
  - MAX_IMAGE_SIZE and request timeout.

Examples:
  - Use when vision_helper_analyze_image fails with "No OpenRouter API key found" to confirm where keys are (or are not) configured.
